data.name: Deadly Throw
data.description: As a swift action, you can expend one use of mythic power to draw a thrown weapon or alchemical item and make a ranged attack with it. This attack doesn't provoke attacks of opportunity. When making a deadly throw, roll twice for the attack, take the higher result, and add +%1 to the roll. If the attack misses, the weapon or alchemical item lands adjacent to the target, regardless of the range.|MythicLevel
